scoring_justification: PL shifts are recomputed from bundled material constants and equations; corrected coefficients compared to paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Material constants for PL shift recomputation (GaN/InN lattice, elastic, deformation, piezoelectric, spontaneous polarization, dielectric constants)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Literature values from Bernardini et al. (1997), Kim et al. (1996), Porowski (1998) – the same references cited by the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the literature values used in the paper's calculations and in the reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual physical constants the paper employed; using different constants would change the computed shifts and deviate from the paper's model.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for corrected piezoelectric polarization discontinuity coefficients (linear and cubic)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text, page 5 (Conclusion section): 'ΔP_PZ^(1) ≈ -3.5 C m⁻²' and 'ΔP_PZ^(3) ≈ -700 C m⁻²'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's reported estimates
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's headline quantities; any correct reproduction must derive the same values from the described procedure.

outputs.description: Strain-dependent PL energy shift for the three InGaN/GaN MQW samples. The checker recomputes expected shifts from bundled material constants and compares the agent's values with an appropriate tolerance.
Estimated linear and cubic piezoelectric polarization discontinuity coefficients. The checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper's hidden gold values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The workflow uses only publicly reported material constants from the cited literature. The experimentally observed PL shifts are provided as fixed inputs. The computed PL shifts must reproduce the correct trend (blue-shift increasing with In content) and magnitudes consistent with the paper's reported calculations.
